Privacy policy

Example text for this demonstration website. It describes the fictional training provider shown here. It is not legal advice, and it is not the privacy policy of a real business.

Who this page is about

Webco Essential is the name of this demonstration. The trainer, the town and the contact details are fictional. Webco Media publishes the demonstration. That does not make Webco Media the training provider.

A real provider would name the organisation responsible for personal data. This page cannot do that, because no real training business is operating this site. No company number, VAT number or registered office is shown, because none belongs to this fictional provider.

The enquiry form

The contact page asks for:

  • Name
  • Phone, if you enter one. It is required only when you choose phone or WhatsApp as the way to reply
  • Email
  • Course: Category C, Category C+E, Driver CPC, or not sure yet
  • Preferred contact method: phone, email, or WhatsApp
  • Message

On this demonstration the form is not connected to a server. Submitting it does not send the message. Nothing you type is stored in a cookie or anywhere else on the site. The words stay in the form on your screen until you leave the page. A note on the form says the same thing.

If you open the contact page from a course button, the address can include the course name so the form selects it for you. That is only so you do not have to choose it again. It is not saved.

Phone, email and WhatsApp

The phone number on this site is 01632 960960. The email address is training@example.com. The WhatsApp number is 07700 900123.These are placeholders. Example Town and Example County are placeholders too.

Choosing a phone link, an email link or a WhatsApp link leaves this website and opens the app on your device. This site does not receive that call, email or chat, and it does not keep a copy.

What this site does not do

  • It does not ask you to create an account
  • It does not take payment
  • It does not add you to a mailing list
  • It does not run analytics or advertising
  • The reviews are sample text, not comments collected from learners

The cookie policy says what this website stores on your device.

Serving the pages

The pages are static files. This project does not run a database. Whoever hosts a copy of the site may keep ordinary server logs, such as an IP address and the page requested. This demonstration does not name a host, because that depends on where a copy is published.

Rights, as an example

People in the UK have rights over personal data a real organisation holds, including access, correction, deletion, restriction and objection, and the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office. This demonstration does not hold enquiry records, so there is nothing here to retrieve or delete.

The contact details above are fictional. They are not a route to a real privacy contact. A live provider replaces this page with their own notice, including who to write to and how long they keep an enquiry.

Also see the cookie policy and thewebsite terms.
